Both responses are correct. Each names chaining and open addressing, lists the probing methods, and gives O(1) average and O(n) worst-case performance. Each also explains resizing when the load factor passes a threshold.

The difference is the "under 120 words" limit, and both break it. A comes to about 123 words and B to about 131. A's extra content is the amortized O(1) insert point and the note that lookups follow the same probe sequence. B adds the O(log n) tree-bucket worst case, clustering, and a typical load-factor threshold. B's extras are accurate and useful, but they push it further over the limit. A is closer to compliance and still covers the key reasoning, so I give it a slight edge.

Verdict: A
